abilities.name: aj604/agentic-atlas-plugin
abilities.description: 基于 Agent 设计模式库构建的托管 MCP 服务器，涵盖上下文经济性、成本转移、调度分发、验证机制等模式，每项均配有论证裁决、实用示例和成熟度标记。让设计技能或多 Agent 系统的 Agent 能在任务执行中检索、权衡并引用适用模式，无需盲目猜测。八个只读工具（`atlas_orient`、`atlas_cards`、`atlas_read`、`atlas_links`、`atlas_provenance`、`atlas_navigate`、`atlas_define`、`atlas_decisions`）形成从词汇定位到具体章节的自适应阶梯，确保调用成本与相关性成正比；每次返回的载荷均包含 Release 版本号作为 `expected_revision` 回传，防止会话期间版本更新产生隐式不一致。Streamable HTTP 端点：`https://agentic-atlas.dev/mcp/`。免鉴权、免 API 密钥、免费。注册表 ID：`dev.agentic-atlas/atlas`。配套 Claude Code 插件：`/plugin marketplace add aj604/agentic-atlas-plugin`。遵循源码可用（Source-available）许可。

zh.name: aj604/agentic-atlas-plugin
zh.description: 基于 Agent 设计模式库构建的托管 MCP 服务器，涵盖上下文经济性、成本转移、调度分发、验证机制等模式，每项均配有论证裁决、实用示例和成熟度标记。让设计技能或多 Agent 系统的 Agent 能在任务执行中检索、权衡并引用适用模式，无需盲目猜测。八个只读工具（`atlas_orient`、`atlas_cards`、`atlas_read`、`atlas_links`、`atlas_provenance`、`atlas_navigate`、`atlas_define`、`atlas_decisions`）形成从词汇定位到具体章节的自适应阶梯，确保调用成本与相关性成正比；每次返回的载荷均包含 Release 版本号作为 `expected_revision` 回传，防止会话期间版本更新产生隐式不一致。Streamable HTTP 端点：`https://agentic-atlas.dev/mcp/`。免鉴权、免 API 密钥、免费。注册表 ID：`dev.agentic-atlas/atlas`。配套 Claude Code 插件：`/plugin marketplace add aj604/agentic-atlas-plugin`。遵循源码可用（Source-available）许可。

en.name: aj604/agentic-atlas-plugin
en.description: Hosted MCP server over a corpus of agent-design patterns — context economy, cost relocation, dispatch, verification — each written up with argued rulings, worked examples and a maturity label, so an agent designing a skill or a multi-agent system can find, weigh and cite an applicable pattern mid-task instead of guessing. Eight read-only tools (`atlas_orient`, `atlas_cards`, `atlas_read`, `atlas_links`, `atlas_provenance`, `atlas_navigate`, `atlas_define`, `atlas_decisions`) form an adaptive ladder from a vocabulary-keyed orient down to one addressed section, so consultation cost stays proportional to relevance; every payload names its Release revision to pass back as `expected_revision`, so a mid-session promotion is refused rather than silently crossed. Streamable HTTP endpoint: `https://agentic-atlas.dev/mcp/`. No auth, no API key, free. Registry id `dev.agentic-atlas/atlas`. Companion Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add aj604/agentic-atlas-plugin`. Source-available license.

en.name: alex-zwingli/plan-to-eat-mcp
en.description: Unofficial client for a personal [Plan to Eat](https://www.plantoeat.com) account — the meal-planning app. Recipe book CRUD (create from a URL or a payload, browse courses, cuisines and tags), the weekly planner (schedule recipes, prep notes and ingredient entries; move, duplicate, reorder within a slot, rescale servings, check for duplicates before scheduling), leftovers as a first-class flow, freezer portion tracking, and the shopping list Plan to Eat generates from the plan. 30 tools. A `plan-to-eat` CLI ships from the same tool registry, so the two surfaces cannot drift. Transport: stdio. Auth: `PLAN_TO_EAT_USERNAME` / `PLAN_TO_EAT_PASSWORD` env vars; the server logs in and caches the cookie session to disk. Clients: Claude Code (ships as a plugin with two skills), Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any stdio MCP host. License: MIT. Requires Node 18+. Install: `npx -y plan-to-eat-mcp` (or `npm i -g plan-to-eat-mcp`; the CLI is the `plan-to-eat` bin from the same package).

en.name: AllNewsAPI/mcp-server

Registry id `io.github.AllNewsAPI/mcp-server`. MIT.

abilities.description: Base 主网上的 14 个按次计费 USDC 工具，单次调用费用仅 $0.001–$0.05 —— 包含 9 个基础功能（哈希锚定、OFAC 制裁名单筛查、签名决策证明、交易与 calldata 解码、ENS/SNS 解析、USD 代币价格、日期时间解析、打包钱包情报）及 5 个通用 LLM 端点（锐评/roast、带锚定判决的预言机/oracle、摘要/tldr、气场分析/aura、打分/grade）。通过 `x402-fetch` + `viem` 实现自动支付；仅需配置 `ANCHOR_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY` 环境变量，无需 API Key。代码硬编码限制向 anchor 国库的每笔签名支付上限为 $0.05 且带有严格的有效窗口，端点即使遭到攻破也无法掏空配置的钱包。安装命令：`npx anchor-x402-mcp`。MIT 协议。

abilities.name: bitterdev/veracrypt-mcp

en.name: bitterdev/veracrypt-mcp
en.description: Mounts and unmounts [VeraCrypt](https://veracrypt.io) containers, so "mount my vault" is enough and the assistant then works on the decrypted files with its ordinary file tools. The password is piped to VeraCrypt over stdin rather than passed as a command line argument, where every process could read it, and it can come from the OS keyring instead of the conversation. Read-only mounts and PIM supported. 3 tools: `mount_container`, `unmount_container`, `list_mounted_containers`. Transport: stdio. License: MIT. Install: `uvx veracrypt-mcp`. abilities.name: ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp
abilities.description: 在官方权威来源——澳大利亚联邦立法名录（Federal Register of Legislation）中检索联邦法律。支持对自 1901 年以来的 13 万余部法案和立法文书进行全文及标题检索，并支持历史特定时间点（point-in-time）检索：该名录记录了每次汇编的确切生效区间，可直接查阅历史某日实际生效的法律文本而非事后重构版本。支持对照名录核验文本块中的法规引用，未颁布条款返回 NOT FOUND，上游故障返回 UNVERIFIED，杜绝将缺失法规误报为不存在。安装：`npx -y australian-law-mcp`。传输协议：stdio。认证：无需 API Key 或注册。许可证：MIT。文档：https://github.com/ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp。工具：`search_law`、`search_full_text`、`get_law_text`、`get_law_as_at`、`verify_citations`、`get_amendment_status`、`compare_versions`、`check_frl_health`。Registry ID：`io.github.ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp`。提供来自官方名录的法律信息，不构成法律建议。

zh.name: ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp
zh.description: 在官方权威来源——澳大利亚联邦立法名录（Federal Register of Legislation）中检索联邦法律。支持对自 1901 年以来的 13 万余部法案和立法文书进行全文及标题检索，并支持历史特定时间点（point-in-time）检索：该名录记录了每次汇编的确切生效区间，可直接查阅历史某日实际生效的法律文本而非事后重构版本。支持对照名录核验文本块中的法规引用，未颁布条款返回 NOT FOUND，上游故障返回 UNVERIFIED，杜绝将缺失法规误报为不存在。安装：`npx -y australian-law-mcp`。传输协议：stdio。认证：无需 API Key 或注册。许可证：MIT。文档：https://github.com/ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp。工具：`search_law`、`search_full_text`、`get_law_text`、`get_law_as_at`、`verify_citations`、`get_amendment_status`、`compare_versions`、`check_frl_health`。Registry ID：`io.github.ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp`。提供来自官方名录的法律信息，不构成法律建议。

en.name: ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp
en.description: Search Australian Commonwealth law on the Federal Register of Legislation, the authorised source. Full-text and title search across 130,000+ acts and legislative instruments back to 1901, plus point-in-time retrieval: the register publishes every compilation with exact in-force windows, so an act can be read as it actually stood on a past date rather than reconstructed. Statute citations in a block of text can be checked against the register, and a section that was never enacted comes back as NOT FOUND while an upstream failure comes back as UNVERIFIED, so a missing law is never reported as nonexistent. Install: `npx -y australian-law-mcp`. Transport: stdio. Auth: none, no API key and no sign-up. License: MIT. Docs URL: https://github.com/ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp. Tools: `search_law`, `search_full_text`, `get_law_text`, `get_law_as_at`, `verify_citations`, `get_amendment_status`, `compare_versions`, `check_frl_health`. Registry id `io.github.ChangkeunJ/australian-law-mcp`. Legal information from the official register, not legal advice.
